g.title: legend_note
g.text: edge colour: the selecting sector (see rows above)
unit is bp for a percent-catalogued
node (to_bp's scaling), else its own unit
dashed + status text = not significant / no_significant_horizon
amber + ⚩ = significant but wrong-signed vs recorded
mechanism - a flagged finding, not an error
constraint=false so it does not affect layer rank
edge labels are PER-EDGE beta (se), not cumulative; a chain's total effect is
the PRODUCT of its edges - see results/tables/chains.csv, not this figure
sector row: name: controlled effect_1sd [ci_low, ci_high] from chains.csv -
asset_managers is broken_link controlled, so its status is shown instead;
central_governments and nfcs repeat ⚩, since their chain contains a
wrong-signed edge and their effect is not a clean transmission result
